title: Building a model railway in Condon's basement
summary: Between sets the band built model trains through the basement walls, with bassist Sid Weiss, one of the happiest times of his life.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: What did you guys used to do with Condon between sets.
Oh, Christ - once we built a railway -- that sounds like a song, don't it?
"once I built a railway" - but anyway, we did - we had model trains in the basement and we built a whole railway down there and, uh, well, the whole
band was in on that one; some guys were building box cars and we had tracks running all over the basement at Conden's through the walls and all around.
That went on for a couple of years I suppose.
Oh, yeah. That's when we had Sid Weiss.
Well, that was probably one of the happiest times of my life - you know - one of them. One of theoutstanding times of my life, outside of the theater.
